title: Disappointing For the High Price I Paid
text:
Disappointing For the High Price I Paid. $139 paid for a vacuum where the tube disconnects so easily while vacuuming! Shame on Oreck for not designing this better. It is upsetting. Do they not test this stuff first before putting it out there for sale?

Unless you buy this only for use with the small attachments connected to the hose, I would recommend you look elsewhere.

Sure, it's lightweight, and suction power is good (especially when using the smaller attachments connected to just the hose).

product_metadata.title: Oreck Compact Canister Vacuum-Handheld Cannister Cleaner & Blower w/HEPA Filter Bag for Dusting Dirt & Dog Hair for Hardwood, Wooden & Tile Floors, BB1200DB, Black
features: VERSATILE USE: Vacuuming has never been easier. Perfect for cleaning on hard floors and carpet, as well as above floor cleaning with the included tools, the BB1200’s powerful bagged performance keeps dirt from escaping back into the air.

HEPA FILTRATION: The vacuum uses a HEPA inner bag combined with an AirClean filter, capturing at least 99. 97% of particles at 0. 3 microns from the air, including pollen, house dirt, smoke, pet dander and spores.

PORTABLE DESIGN: Weighing less than 5. 5 pounds, the BB1200 Vacuum is easy to carry or wear over your shoulder with its adjustable strap for easy maneuverability. It also features a 20- foot power cord that wraps around the bottom to stay out of your way.

DOUBLES AS A BLOWER: With a switch of the hose, you can go from vacuuming dirt to blowing away dirt particles in your garage, home or work space to ensure you efficiently clean every nook and cranny in any location.

INCLUDED TOOLS: With a flexible hose, telescopic extension wand and on-board tools, you can conveniently clean objects above the floor. Vacuum hard-to-reach areas, cracks, crevices, upholstery, ceiling fans and more with ease.
